feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 23 November 2026 12:00pm
items.description:
##Today##

Dry for much of today with some areas of cloud, as well as bright or sunny intervals at times, then with some patchy rain arriving later this evening. Moderate to fresh southeast winds becoming strong this evening. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Risk of coastal overtopping around high tide later (~10:15pm). Strong winds soon developing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

South or southeast 15-20, increasing southeast 20-25 later this afternoon and occasionally 32 this evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later. Hill fog increasing later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Outbreaks of rain on Tuesday starting patchy at first, then becoming persistent and heavy at times from mid-morning onwards. Strong to gale force southeast wind only slowly decreasing later, highest temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds. Gales for a time. Significant coastal overtopping around the times of high tide (~10:30am and ~11pm). Risk of localised flooding due to heavy rain.

##Visibility##

##Comments##

Nil.


##Wednesday, 25 November 2026##

Outbreaks of rain at first on Wednesday tending to peter out later in the morning, although staying largely cloudy for the rest of the day. Fresh to strong southeast wind backing east or southeast and decreasing later. Highest temperature 8°C. Comments: Strong winds until later. Risk of coastal overtopping around high tide (~11:15am and ~11:45pm)

##Thursday, 26 November 2026##

Dry for much of the day on Thursday with variable amounts of cloud. Cloud then thickening later with the risk of a few outbreaks of rain. Southeast wind steadily increasing through the day, top temperature 7°C. Comments: Strong winds soon developing.

Outbreaks of rain that may be heavy at times. Fresh to strong southeast wind easing later in the day and a top temperature of 8°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of heavy rain.
